Container.Name: shelfsort
Container.Overview: Organizes an ebook collection (books, magazines, plans and articles): scans sources, identifies files, plans renames and moves, writes metadata, with undo and quarantine. No login: use only on a trusted LAN.

Config.Name: Remote NAS books
Config.Description: Your NAS share. Mount it first with the Unassigned Devices plugin (Add Remote SMB/NFS Share), then enter the resulting /mnt/remotes/... path here.

Config.Name: BookOrbit library
Config.Description: The share BookOrbit uses for its library.
